detail: Acl2Session (tests/native_harness.py:813) starts '<developer image> --fn acl2 session' with SBCL_USER_ARGS '--control-stack-size 64MB' only. The launcher (build/fn-host-developer, LAUNCHER-STACK-ARGS-REPLACE-DECIDED-HEAP since train 63) composes a stack-only caller with the decided heap, and 'heap -- acl2 session' answers heap=1024 MB profile=none. Repro on hbox at image d8fb738b3: the 10 MiB article defconst succeeds, then (fn-bpa-encode (fn-bpa-make-request ...)) dies 'Heap exhausted during garbage collection' at 1,063,960,464 of 1,073,741,824 octets, in SB-IMPL::APPEND2 under ACL2::FN-BPA-ENCODE-FIELDS. The fixture's scratch-seam repair (fb42ea133) holds: setUp passes. The session is the test's own ACL2, not the node under test (the harness's own comment); it names its stack and should name its heap the same way, from what its work needs, rather than take a node's store-less decision. Owner to decide the figure (the save-exec image's own dynamic space, or a size derived from the session's largest literal); until then the fixture keeps its 09-28 bytes and refuses as schema-unrecorded.
